_comment: The application commit this workflow is approved to deploy.
A 40-hex app_sha input establishes SYNTAX, not approval. Every commit on
every branch is 40 hex characters. This file is the approval, it lives on
the default branch, and changing it is a reviewed change.
The candidate checkout never supplies its own approval: this file is read
from the operational checkout (the commit the workflow itself ran from),
never from the application commit under deployment.
Future acceptances are a one-line edit here, reviewed like any other.
packageLabel: Expo package, plus the Champion Manage sheet rebuilt event first: the kiosk address for a running goal is the event section's own content rather than a control inside that goal's public-display permission; screens enrol for either kiosk mode; and Goals, Members and invites, and Advanced are labelled sections beneath it. Frontend only.

_uiOnlyPromotionNote: 70ace552da60acba00b9e889f53ee0e05dd92b85 is a single commit whose parent IS 15afae974302d2624524a9ddbfdb7952c4180d4a. Its delta is one product source file (apps/westayfit/app/community/[groupId]/index.tsx), two Playwright specs and 43 documentation and capture files. functions-westayfit/, .github/, functions/ and apps/goarrive/ are IDENTICAL tree objects; firestore.rules, firestore.indexes.json, firebase.json, firebase.westayfit.json, firebase.westayfit.emulators.json and .firebaserc are IDENTICAL blobs. The functions deploy this workflow performs is therefore a no-op on function CODE, and it does not disturb the staging transport configuration: run 35450108207 redeployed functions at 14:58Z, AFTER the 10-service remediation, and the CANDIDATE_SERVICE_TRANSPORT reading at 15:00Z still showed those ten as invoker_iam_check_disabled.
_twelveStillShutNote: wsfeventcontext, wsfjointurnline, wsfturnready, wsfmyturn, wsfcompletemyturn, wsfleaveturnline, wsfcreatecombinedgoal, wsfclosecombinedgoal, wsfrepaircombinedgoal, wsfapprovestation, wsfliststations and wsfrevokestation remain invoker_iam_check_enabled as of run 35450108207.
